scope: Assistant inspection of three targeted website smoke outputs, not independent human review or thesis evaluation.
language_direction: All three outputs attempt the selected language; native fluency is not established.

taglish.finding: Uses Tagalog sentence structure but mistranslates building as bilyahan. It repeats requirements and assigns some conditions/citations incompletely.

bislish.finding: Uses Cebuano mixed with English and Tagalog; awkward phrases remain. Source coverage includes scaffolding/fence material and is not a verified full building-permit checklist.

english.finding: English output preserved; OCBD-issued wording is not established by its cited excerpt. Not a factual-certification pass.

deployment_scope: Temporary research demo only; language control implemented, fluency and factual adequacy remain unresolved.
unresolved: Do not describe these tests as establishing safe or accurate citizen service advice. Preserve the observed failures for separate post-study quality work.
